articleTitle: The DRIVE programme in the European Community
abstract: The DRIVE (dedicated road infrastructure for vehicle safety in Europe) programme is an initiative of the Commission of the European Community with the objectives of improving road safety, improving road transport efficiency, and reducing environmental pollution. These objectives are to be achieved through the application of road transport informatics (RTI) both to road vehicles and to the roadside infrastructure. An overview of the programme is given.<<ETX xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">></ETX>

articleTitle: PROMETHEUS-The European research programme for optimising the road transport system in Europe
abstract: PROMETHEUS is a research programme launched by the European automotive industry, intended to work out concepts and draw up possible solutions aimed at improving all areas of European road traffic, i.e. making driving in Europe safer, more economical, more environmentally acceptable, more comfortable and more efficient. PROMETHEUS stands for 'programme for a European traffic with highest efficiency and unprecedented safety'. Information technology is used to provide onboard drives assistance-in particular an anti-lock braking system to prevent locking of wheels-inter-vehicle communications; and vehicle-roadside communications. The stages of the project, and its progress so far, are outlined.<<ETX xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">></ETX>

articleTitle: Current practice and developments in the Automobile Association
abstract: Gives an outline of two databases run by the AA; a route information system and Roadwatch. The former prepares routes for the information of drivers, and therefore contains details of roads, signposts, places of interest and other useful information. Roadwatch contains current traffic information (weather, roadworks, congestion etc.), and serves mainly TV and radio stations and a telephone information service.<<ETX xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">></ETX>
